inputs.text: This looks like a managed conflict, not just DHS opportunistically spinning one arrest. The release and federal response create a spectacle that keeps people angry at each other while the institutions driving the escalation avoid scrutiny. The public-safety argument is being used to make this case stand in for all sanctuary policies, diverting attention from who benefits when a local decision becomes a federal showdown.

output.main_topic: Critique of a federal-local conflict framed as a spectacle that diverts scrutiny from institutional escalation
